notes: Build94 adds an explainable classification-only Intent & Capability Router for CODE, DATABASE, GIT, CONTEXT, TEST, RUNTIME and DEPLOY, with MIXED and UNRESOLVED outcomes. Explicit signals become required capabilities; implicit signals remain candidates and are never autoactivated. The canonical Composer routes before PLAN/BUILD. PLAN may explain any route without writing; BUILD fails closed when the route is unresolved or requires capabilities not yet implemented by the canonical Build94 execution path. Build94 executable capabilities remain CODE, CONTEXT and TEST. DATABASE is deliberately deferred to Build95. The router never calls tools, Git, database, deploy, approval or write authority and cannot override Scope Intelligence, Human Intent or Continuity.
